options.text: 7 rounds (formula: $N - 1 = 8 - 1 = 7$)
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately solves the problem for Rounds in Cyclic Method (Even Teams).

options.text: 4 rounds
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: 14 rounds
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: 8 rounds
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For Rounds in Cyclic Method (Even Teams) (Yoga and Yogic Practices):
When N is even in cyclic method, Rounds = $N - 1 = 8 - 1 = 7$ rounds.
Therefore, option (A) is the correct answer.
